entry.name: mc.generate~
entry.digest: Generate Values for a Range of Channels
entry.description: The mc.generate~ object allows signal-rate updating of MC Wrapper features such as deviate, spread, and harmonic as a trigger signal or parameter inputs change. One wrapper message is assigned as an operator.

messages.name: float
messages.description: A number in the second inlet sets value of the first parameter. A number in the third inlet sets the value of the second parameter. A number in the right inlet sets the third parameter.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: A signal in the left inlet triggers a calculation of the current operator. Signals in the other three inlets set parameter values.

inlets.description: A connected input signal triggers a new calculation of the current operator when the value goes from zero to non-zero.
A signal or float supplies the first parameter of the current operator.
A signal or float supplies the second parameter of the current operator.
A signal or float supplies the third (optional) parameter of the current operator.

outlets.description: The signals containing the values of the current operator's calculation.
